scripts/install.sh	SC2016	AGENT_PROGRAM='r="$(/usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict "-R=$1" "$2" 2>&1)" && exec /bin/bash "$2/Contents/Resources/backstop.sh"; mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Logs/Insomnia"; printf "%s [error] backstop agent: %s does not satisfy the pinned code requirement; backstop.sh not run. Reinstall Insomnia (scripts/install.sh). codesign: %s\n" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$2" "$(printf %s "$r" | tr "\n" " ")" >> "$HOME/Library/Logs/Insomnia/insomnia.log"; exit 1'
scripts/uninstall.sh	SC2034	BOUNDED_PID="$(cat "$base.pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
